newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds market subdued by high prices.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds market subdued by high prices.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds market was subdued by the higher prices on Friday following the firm close in Chicago on Thursday.
"People are beginning to accept that the high prices are here to stay for now, but they are still not trading," said one broker.
Brokers said there a few odds and ends of business being done, but nothing worth reporting.
"We did nothing all morning, but buyers are sniffing around this afternoon," said one.
High protein soymeal was up around five stg from the mill and around four stg ex-store.
Brazilian 48's were around four stg up.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was one stg up to unchanged while resellers were two stg higher to unchanged.
At the Liverpool and Hull mills prices were two stg above Thursday's levels.
Corn gluten feed pellets were unchanged while sunflower pellets ex-mill were two stg down.
Sunflowermeal offers for import material on the East Coast were one stg higher.
